provenance: Original selected concrete nouns combined with the unchanged binding-v2 literal templates and source-derived answers. No imported model weights, teacher predictions or downloaded synthetic dataset.
selection_reason: Increase reusable entity identities and varied pairings while retaining short familiar syntax, equal word lengths, four locations and unchanged original development/test pairs.
split_policy: All unordered pairs from the 24 selected objects are training except the original six held-out binding-v2 pairs. Both orders, query targets, styles and every location assignment of each held-out pair stay excluded. Original development and test probes are copied byte for byte.
assessment: Primary development score uses the unchanged 144 four-answer binding-v2 groups. Original training groups and a preselected sample of 432 expanded-training groups are reported separately. The latter is a monitor, not full expanded-training accuracy.
limits: This changes vocabulary diversity, corpus size and repetition rate together at a fixed update budget. It is not a pure vocabulary-size ablation, broad dialogue corpus or validated biological age curriculum. Reserved tests are not used for tuning.
